MAQUETTISTE_MODE.description: local (also when empty) or hosted; phase 2 answers 503 model-unavailable in hosted mode.

MAQUETTISTE_REPO_ROOT.description: The repository root the model and the outputs belong to (EngineOptions.RepoRoot); /repo in the image.

MAQUETTISTE_EDITOR_TOKEN.description: When set, every caller signs in with it (bearer token or the sign-in page's cookie); empty in local mode means nobody signs in.

MAQUETTISTE_CACHE_DIR.description: Root of the engine's index cache, plans and jobs, on the host volume (/data/maquettiste/cache in the image).

MAQUETTISTE_WORKSPACE.description: The workspace name the top bar and GET /api/project show (a folder or branch name); empty means the git branch, else the worktree name.

MAQUETTISTE_HOST_AI_URL.description: Where the host's management UI is, linked from Settings, Assistant (the AI provider and model are set there); empty means no link.

MAQUETTISTE_LOCAL_USER.description: The user name of the local developer (presence).
